trigger_description: The currently-granted master's address low byte equals 0x37 AND that master's write-enable (we_i) is asserted, same cycle (P=2^-9 under random traffic; zero collisions against the golden testbench's actual write addresses 0x40/0x44).
observable_effect: Bit 0 of the data word forwarded to the shared slave (s_dat_o) is flipped for that one cycle's write transaction only -- a single-bit write-data corruption in the arbiter's own datapath mux, not a routing/grant/handshake change.
